verdict.reason: Four of the five candidates are specific neurological conditions or deficits: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (a motor neuron disease), ataxia (loss of motor coordination), athetosis (involuntary writhing movements) and atopognosia (inability to localize a touch sensation). Each is a kind or sign of nervous disorder. 'Disorder' is the direct hypernym. Taken together, the set is strongly related to the concept.
